## 14. The closure nodes

| id | what it is | members | duties blocked |
|---|---|---|---|
| X:DICT | THE DICTIONARY. Which mathematical object is which field. Unearned everywhere; unearnable by derivation inside the flat counting frames; earnable by sealed prediction. | 13 | D:01, D:02, D:05, D:06, D:07 |
| X:END | THE END. The law at the cusp. Tagged on the weave, chosen in the value frame, a conditional reduction in the lanes' model. | 9 | D:03, D:04, D:06 |
| X:FLAT | THE FLATNESS. Both value frames stand on a flat bundle, which cannot reach continuous moduli. | 3 | D:10 |
| X:GRAVITY | GRAVITY IN 3+1. Not on the record in any lane. | 2 | D:11 |
| X:HAND | THE HAND. What makes a count chiral. Every branch meets it: the weave derives neither hand, the flat index is mirror-even, the 2+1 matter is vector-like, and the lanes' model has paired left and right currents. | 16 | D:06, D:07, D:08 |
| X:PARENT | THE PARENT. Where the gauge algebra comes from. Supplied in the lanes' model; adopted by a ruling as a container on main; one of five typed inputs of the structural theorem. | 4 | D:02, D:05 |
| X:SCALE | THE SCALE. One outside unit is unavoidable; every dimensionless ratio of scales still waits on a level and an identification. | 10 | D:10, D:11 |
| X:SELECT | THE SELECTION. What makes a state, a line or a background the physical one. A postulate at the root, open above it, unselected data in the lanes' model. | 13 | D:03, D:12 |
| X:SOURCE | THE DYNAMICS. A potential, a breaking, a running or a source that fixes a value. Structure exists; nothing has been turned into one. | 10 | D:03, D:04, D:10 |
| X:TAU | THE MODULUS. What fixes τ. Fitted in both value frames, unselected in the lanes' model, forced by nothing on the weave; a rule exists that is conditional on a chosen framing and three further choices. | 11 | D:10, D:12 |
| X:WEIGHT | THE WEIGHT. If everything allowed happens, how much of each. The law fixes what exists and not its weight; a thread picked by hand and a flat average are the two ways of supplying the weight without deriving it. | 11 | D:10, D:12, D:13 |
